feedback.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to  $\operatorname{tanh}⁡\sqrt{u}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The definition of $\operatorname{tanh}⁡x$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡x & =\frac{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{2x}-1}{{e}^{2x}+1} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-2x}}{1+{e}^{-2x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the second definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡\sqrt{u} & =\frac{{e}^{2\sqrt{u}}-1}{{e}^{2\sqrt{u}}+1}.\end{aligned}
$$
